import parse
from datetime import datetime

# Create expected
tz60 = parse.FixedTzOffset(60, '+01:00')

# Parse +0100
r = parse.parse('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b')
print('Parsed +0100:')
print('  datetime:', r.fixed[0])

expected_dt = datetime(1997, 7, 16, 19, 20, tzinfo=tz60)
print('Expected datetime:', expected_dt)
print()
print('Are they equal?', r.fixed[0] == expected_dt)
print('Timezone info equal?', r.fixed[0].tzinfo == expected_dt.tzinfo)
"
